label: Schmitt

semantics.notes: Schmitt trigger inverter. Binary passthrough with Schmitt-trigger symbol. UI representation only; behavioral model is simple passthrough. verilogSkipUnconnectedOutputs=true.

exportSupport.verilogNotes: assign y = ~a; (passthrough with inversion — Schmitt hysteresis not modelled in simulation)

testability.notes: Behavioral model: Y = NOT(A). Hysteresis is a UI/schematic symbol feature, not simulated.

risks.description: Schmitt hysteresis (VT+ / VT- thresholds) is not modelled in simulation — only a binary passthrough/inversion.

modelLimits: No hysteresis modelling — thresholds are not simulated.
